claim: Once hooks change cycle counts, lockstep replay diverges and proves nothing; instead copy the state at each patched routine, run both to the return and compare registers (except R, T, MEMPTR) and memory.

evidence.text: Maintainers' note: this method worked on every game; registers that differ at return are acceptable only if they converge or are overwritten before use.
Verify is done per site: original and patched run from one state to the common resume point, comparing all registers but R/T/MEMPTR and all memory but dead stack.
evidence.quote: original and patched from one state to the common resume point, all registers but R/T/MEMPTR
